findings.vulnerability: Missing rate limiting on authentication endpoint
findings.attack_vector: Attacker performs credential stuffing against POST /auth/login with no throttle applied
findings.mitigation: Add rate limiting middleware capped at 5 login attempts per minute per IP address

findings.vulnerability: JWT secret management not specified in spec
findings.attack_vector: Hardcoded or weak JWT secret exposed via source code repository
findings.mitigation: Require JWT_SECRET via environment variable; fail startup if absent or shorter than 32 characters

security.summary: Specification has medium threat exposure. No blockers found. Rate limiting on the auth endpoint is absent and JWT secret management is unspecified. Address the WARN before build proceeds.
